song_sections.name: intro
song_sections.note: Palm-muted chord-root 8ths while guitar 2 plays a high ostinato with feedback bends

song_sections.name: verse
song_sections.note: Screamed verse (Chamberlain) — the clean voice sits out

micro.name: B
micro.note: Opens into strummed power chords, faster hardcore beat

song_sections.name: pre-chorus
song_sections.note: Scream section — ringing open chords, cymbal wash, fill into the chorus

song_sections.name: chorus
song_sections.note: Clean sung hook (Gillespie) over big strummed open chords; keys and pad fill out the top

song_sections.name: post-chorus
song_sections.note: Riff tag after the chorus, screams return

song_sections.name: breakdown
song_sections.note: Palm-muted VI-VII chugs, beat switched from 4/4 to 3/4, kick doubles the chugs

song_sections.name: interlude
song_sections.note: Loop-based instrumental (The Blue Note): programmed beat, keys and pad only

song_sections.name: solo
song_sections.note: Acoustic break — strummed/arpeggiated acoustic guitar under a soft clean vocal

song_sections.name: bridge
song_sections.note: Clean maj7 bridge over an electronica beat; a choir pad enters (It's Dangerous Business...)

song_sections.name: stop
song_sections.note: Silence, then the distortion comes back in

song_sections.name: outro
song_sections.note: Chorus chords ring out to the end

principles: Half screamed, half sung — screamed verses and scream sections answered by a clean, melodic chorus hook (the drummer sings)
Two guitars with different jobs: guitar 1 strums palm-muted 8ths and big open chords in standard/drop D; guitar 2 plays a high single-note ostinato with feedback bends
Emo-pop harmony in minor keys — i-III-VI-VII, i-VI-VII-iv, i-VI-iv-VI loops, maj7 colour in the bridge, catchy and diatonic rather than heavy
Dynamics and texture over brutality — dance beats under choruses, a 3/4 breakdown, keys/synths and electronica beats, a clean or acoustic break, choir in the bridge

synth_presets.pad: warm pad; choir tone in the bridge

sound_design.notes: Less gain than metalcore. Guitars: Odin III in drop D — Amped Rhythm for guitar 1, Amped Lead for guitar 2, a separate Odin instance on Amped Clean for the '(clean)' track; the '(acoustic)' track wants an acoustic guitar VST or GM. Drums: Superior Drummer 3 with a rock kit; Beatmaker (VOID suits the electronica beats). Melody is the clean-vocal guide line.

notes: Modelled on Underoath's They're Only Chasing Safety (2004). Introduced: per-section meter (3/4 breakdown), per-section instrument tones (clean / acoustic guitar, choir pad), vocal_line phrasing, guitar-2 pedal_ostinato, palm_eighths riffs, guitar_open voicing, maj7 chords.
